description: This file contains functions for downloading a browser with progress indication, including handling retries, progress bars, and inter-process communication. It is part of the Playwright core package, specifically related to browser fetching and installation.

methods.name: downloadBrowserWithProgressBar
methods.description: Downloads a browser with a progress bar, handling retries and cleanup.

methods.name: downloadBrowserWithProgressBarOutOfProcess
methods.description: Performs the download in a separate process and checks for success.

methods.name: logPolitely
methods.description: Logs messages to the console unless the log level suppresses output.

methods.name: getDownloadProgress
methods.description: Returns a progress callback based on whether the output is TTY.

methods.name: getAnimatedDownloadProgress
methods.description: Provides animated progress bar updates for TTY output.

methods.name: getBasicDownloadProgress
methods.description: Provides simple textual progress updates for non-TTY output.

methods.name: toMegabytes
methods.description: Converts bytes to a human-readable megabytes string.
